Nice scent but doesn’t last long
Reviewed in the United States on May 2, 2026
Scent: BombshellSize: 1.7 Fl Oz (Pack of 1)
Verified Purchase

I was excited to try Victoria’s Secret Bombshell because it’s such a well-known fragrance, but my experience was just okay.

The scent is nice at first—fruity and floral like described—but I didn’t find it very smooth on my skin. It feels a bit sharp when you first spray it, and it doesn’t really settle into something softer like I expected. Also, the biggest issue for me is that the fragrance doesn’t last long at all. Within a short time, I can barely smell it anymore, so I find myself reapplying often.

Overall, it’s an average perfume for me. The scent is pleasant, but the performance and longevity are disappointing, so I’d rate it 4 stars.
